entries.subject: Wild 2 NAVCAM normalization using Li 2009 Hapke parameters
entries.finding: The diagnostic trial reduces accepted photographed area from 39.52% to 29.73%; 5 of 6 common-point overlap pairs improve. The running app shows large new grid gaps in photographed depressions. Retain the observed photographs. Parameters were checked in Li 2013 Table 6, but the original H-function approximation is unverified.
entries.revisitWhen: A verified original model formulation and source-normal or coverage evidence can support normalization without discarding the photographed terrain.

entries.subject: Wild 2 N2081 camera registration using N2079WE02 image overlap
entries.finding: Matching calibrated radiance now finds 13 fit and 11 holdout controls, but the camera fails the unchanged 1-pixel RMS and 2-pixel maximum limits. Fit RMS is 9.84 pixels; holdout RMS is 17.84 pixels. N2081 is not added to the mosaic.
entries.revisitWhen: New source attitude or intrinsics, independent terrain controls, or an independently qualified registration method resolves the residuals without relaxing the existing positional limits.

entries.subject: Wild 2 N2081 camera registration using N2077WE02 image overlap
entries.finding: Matching calibrated radiance now finds 9 fit and 10 holdout controls, but the camera fails the unchanged 1-pixel RMS and 2-pixel maximum limits. Fit RMS is 16.78 pixels; holdout RMS is 5.66 pixels. N2081 is not added to the mosaic.
entries.revisitWhen: New source attitude or intrinsics, independent terrain controls, or an independently qualified registration method resolves the residuals without relaxing the existing positional limits.

entries.subject: PDS v2.1 observed and completed Wild 2 mesh
entries.finding: The full PDS Cartesian model supplies the closed scene, including the archive authors' estimated rear and joining faces. Observed-only and planetocentric products are retained for comparison; equivalent coordinate products do not create separate datasets.

entries.subject: Calibrated NAVCAM N2073, N2075 and N2077
entries.finding: The v3 short exposures form the core photographic mosaic. Their frame binding and translation checks use the original observed source mesh; estimated faces remain grid and original illumination remains visible.

entries.subject: NAVCAM N2079 footprint extension
entries.finding: The recorded trial passes nine fitting and six withheld topographic controls under the 85 m RMS and 170 m maximum budgets. Its coarser sampling has lower priority where the closer accepted images qualify.

entries.subject: Earlier NAVCAM N2069
entries.finding: The earlier frame is retained as trajectory evidence for the source mapping frame, not as a displayed photographic source.

entries.subject: Earlier NAVCAM N2071
entries.finding: The source note records this frame as surveyed but does not preserve a separate quantitative rejection or an accepted mosaic footprint. Its photographic suitability remains unqualified.
entries.revisitWhen: A concrete footprint and registration comparison can demonstrate useful coverage beyond the selected sequence.

entries.subject: NAVCAM N2081 direct topographic matching
entries.finding: The earlier direct topography-to-image trial produced only four fit and four holdout patches, below the six-control minimum. Today's two image-overlap alternatives have separate entries and also fail qualification.
entries.revisitWhen: Additional independent terrain controls satisfy the existing count and positional budgets.

entries.subject: Long-exposure NAVCAM alternates
entries.finding: The surveyed long exposures emphasize jets and saturate the nucleus. They do not replace the short-exposure surface photographs.
entries.revisitWhen: A detector-valid unsaturated nucleus footprint is demonstrated in a specific alternate frame.

entries.subject: Published Stooke Wild 2 cylindrical mosaic
entries.finding: The investigated mosaic reports positional errors that can approach ten degrees. It was not selected over registered native camera observations.
entries.revisitWhen: A corrected map or independent registration demonstrates adequate accuracy on the chosen source shape.

entries.subject: Earlier disk normalization using coarse facet normals
entries.finding: The earlier correction imprinted source-facet patterns onto the photographs. The later smooth-normal Hapke trial is recorded separately and also does not replace the observed mosaic.
entries.revisitWhen: An independently checked normal and photometric treatment preserves observed coverage and removes the facet artifacts.

entries.subject: Mayo, Left Foot and Right Foot landmarks
entries.finding: The published diagram and photograph are tied to the native N2073 camera and source mesh through measured image controls. Labels denote approximate feature interiors, not exact boundaries or a new absolute cartographic solution.
